# Oakhaven Print — queue journal

One line per event: <timestamp> <LEVEL> <service> job=<job id> <message>. The queue manager re-sent some alarm lines unchanged (same timestamp and job), so a job can appear twice. A queue flood is an ERROR whose message opens with 'queue flood'. Banner lines open with === and are not events.
